speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I see you are experiencing fatigue, fever, abdominal pain, and nausea. To begin our assessment, how would you describe the location and nature of your abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old female. The patient describes a 3-week history of generalized fatigue, mild fever, abdominal pain, and nausea. She recalls attending the state fair over a month ago where she tried various regional foods. Recently, she has observed the darkening of her urine, which she believes is due to inadequate water intake. She has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; the fair attendance and dark urine are concerning. Given your 3-week history of fever, abdominal pain, nausea, and fatigue, have you noticed any jaundice (yellowing of your skin or eyes), right upper quadrant pain, or changes in stool color like clay-colored stools?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and mild fever. I also have Abdominal pain, Nausea, Dark urine.
